author: The EmbeddingGemma 2 team

blocks.text: We released EmbeddingGemma 2, which expands our text-only open embedding model with native multimodal understanding. It maps text, images, audio, and video, or any combination of them, into a single embedding space, all while compressing the model backbone into a more compact profile.
blocks.zh: 我们释放了EmbeddingGemma 2,扩展我们仅文本的开放式嵌入模式,并具有本土的多模式理解。它映射了文本,图像,音频,和视频,或任何组合,进入一个单一的嵌入空间,将模型主干线压缩成更紧凑的配置 。
blocks.en: We released EmbeddingGemma 2, which expands our text-only open embedding model with native multimodal understanding. It maps text, images, audio, and video, or any combination of them, into a single embedding space, all while compressing the model backbone into a more compact profile.

blocks.text: You can now get in-depth information about our training strategy, evaluation methodology, and experimental results in the official technical report. The model’s recipe features innovations that build on top of the latest technology from Gemma 4 and Gemini Embedding 2, enabling EmbeddingGemma 2 to learn an expressive and unified vector space.
blocks.zh: 你现在可以得到关于我们训练战略的深入信息,评价方法,以及正式技术报告中的实验结果。该模型的配方以Gemma 4和Gemini嵌入2的最新技术为基础进行创新。使 EmbeddingGemma 2 能够学习一个表达和统一的向量空间.
blocks.en: You can now get in-depth information about our training strategy, evaluation methodology, and experimental results in the official technical report. The model’s recipe features innovations that build on top of the latest technology from Gemma 4 and Gemini Embedding 2, enabling EmbeddingGemma 2 to learn an expressive and unified vector space.
